component.name: Monica
component.summary: 本地优先的 Linux 密码库

description.p: Monica by Linux is a local-first desktop vault for passwords, secure notes, authenticators, and wallet items. The GTK4 line follows the system theme, uses fontconfig for CJK, and talks to the desktop through xdg-desktop-portal and StatusNotifierItem.
Monica 的 Linux 桌面密码库：本地优先，覆盖登录、安全笔记、动态口令和钱包。 GTK4 线跟随系统主题，字体走 fontconfig，平台能力走 portal 与托盘。
Vault files stay on the machine as canonical MDBX. This client never upgrades MDBX-1 in place. Online sync is not included in this release.
密码库以 MDBX 落在本机。本客户端不会原地把 MDBX-1 升级为 MDBX-2。 当前版本不含在线同步。
Phase 5 packaging preview: Flatpak (GNOME runtime), deb, and RPM.
Phase 5 打包预览：GNOME runtime 的 Flatpak，以及 deb / RPM。
